messages.subject: ShinyApp runs locally/Fails to start on Shinyapps.io [Continuation from yesterday, but different errors]
parts:
This is from yesterday. I wrote the app.R the write way from the shiny tutorial

Set directory: C:\Users\tcwfzp\Desktop\Optimal+\ProbeShinyApp
My app.R file and the csv data source file are in my shinyapp folder. RsConnect folder inside the shiny app folder

Request help from the experts here.
 The following is my shinyapp code in my app.R file. I am using the single file method.

library(shiny)
ForApp = read.csv("ProbeTestTimesDetail.csv",header = TRUE)
ui <- pageWithSidebar(headerPanel("Probe Test Time Report (last 12 weeks)"),sidebarPanel(checkboxGroupInput("show_vars", "Statistics to display", names(ForApp), selected = names(ForApp))),
                      
                      mainPanel(dataTableOutput("TestTimeMeasures")))


server <- function(input, output){
  rowSelect <- reactive({
    if(is.null(input[["row"]])) 1
    else as.numeric(input[["row"]])
  })
  
  output$TestTimeMeasures = renderDataTable({
    
    cbind(ForApp[, input$show_vars, drop = FALSE])
  }, options = list(bSortClasses = TRUE, aLengthMenu = c(10,25,50), iDisplayLength = 50))
  options(digits = 2)
}
shinyApp(ui = ui, server = server)



Logs: I am no longer using absolute referencing. But I still get the same error. I also get cannot open the connection error.
